item.tib: sgrib sbyong sngon dngos rjes gsum gyi don khrid kyi rim pa gzhan phan bdud rtsi
item.coloph: ces sgrib sbyong don khrid kyi rim pa 'di ni ring nas dbal khyung mchog sprul g.yung drung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dbang po sogs dam pa du ma'i gsung gis bskal ngor dang rang nyid kyi mos pas kyang yid drangs te bla ma gong ma'i gsung la gzhi byas nas kun gsal snying por dril ba'i tshul du khod spungs dbra zhig ston pa bskal (skal) bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas g.yu rong smin grol gling du nye bar bkod pa'o//
